name: p7-pull-swap
notes: P7 (corrupt-events): a queued sticky PULL (type 1) executes along the swapped-in facing. Sticky piston A faces up, extended by the west torch; stone at (2,2,0). Chord window 0: break the torch (queues a type-1 retract; the up two-ahead cell is air), break A, place a sticky piston facing east. The event pulls the stone from (2,2,0) to (1,2,0). Baseline (no chord): A retracts upward normally, the stone stays.
